header: THE FOUR POLICE STATIONS THAT THE ROLL NAMES for the wards and gram panchayats of Durgapur, with what the Asansol-Durgapur Police Commissionerate's own site says about each (address, zone, its page). Which areas are under which station is in data.ts (the "থানা" line of each roll part); this file holds what is true of a station itself: its address, its telephone numbers as the Commissionerate and the Municipal Corporation publish them, whom it reports to, and the investigation centres and outposts that work under it. I do NOT keep the name of an officer (they change); a telephone number can change too, so the card says where each was read and when (POLICE_SOURCES) and links the station's own page. Pure data, no React.

symbols.name: PoliceUnit
doc: An investigation centre (IC) or an outpost (OP / TOP): a small post that works under a station. `src` says which publication names it and, for the station it is under, which one says so.
